fields.description: Relays a mint request to OpenAI's realtime client-secrets endpoint and returns the ephemeral secret plus the model id (NOT wrapped in a data envelope). 403 unless the request host is local or VENDO_DEMO_PUBLIC=1; 503 without OPENAI_API_KEY. Stores nothing.
fields.title: Start a voice session

fields.description: Fetches one client by id with received/total document progress, the status derived from its documents (missing_docs / in_review / complete) and the assigned staff record. 404 for an unknown id. Reads only.
fields.title: Look up one client

host_getClient.evidence:
const client = getClientSummary(id)
  return client ? ok(client) : notFound(`Unknown client: ${id}`)

fields.description: Computes firm-wide counters from the stored documents: clients with at least one outstanding document, documents outstanding (missing or rejected) vs received (everything else), totals, and the soonest filing deadline with its client. Pure computation.
fields.title: Show firm-wide document metrics

fields.description: Returns the firm-wide activity log from the in-memory store, already newest-first: uploads received, documents verified or rejected, messages sent, deadlines approaching. Each row carries a type, summary, ISO timestamp and usually a clientId. An optional positive `limit` truncates. Reads only.
fields.title: List recent firm activity

host_listActivity.evidence:
const events = getStore().activity
  return ok(limit !== undefined && Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0 ? events.slice(0, limit) : events)

fields.description: Returns one client's document checklist: each requested kind with its lifecycle status, the attached file name and upload time when present, and any rejection or review note. 404 if the client id is unknown. Reads only.
fields.title: List a client's requested documents

host_listClientDocuments.evidence:
if (!store.clients.some(c => c.id === id)) return notFound(`Unknown client: ${id}`)
  return ok(store.documents.filter(d => d.clientId === id))

fields.description: Returns the full message thread between the firm and one client, oldest first, each entry tagged with its direction and author. 404 if the client id is unknown. Reads only.
fields.title: Read a client's message thread

host_listClientMessages.evidence:
const thread = store.messages
    .filter(m => m.clientId === id)
    .sort((a, b) => +new Date(a.sentAt) - +new Date(b.sentAt))

fields.description: Returns every client in the firm (optionally only those with outstanding documents, or matching a case-insensitive name search) with received/total document counts, a status derived from the documents, and the assigned staff member. Reads only.
fields.title: List clients and their document progress

fields.description: Every client ordered by filing deadline, soonest first, each with document progress, derived status and missingDocKinds — the kinds still outstanding (missing or rejected), empty when the checklist is done. Reads only.
fields.title: List clients by filing deadline

fields.description: Reads the signed-in subject's pre-generated "try this" prompt manifest and returns key + prompt per chip. An unauthenticated caller, a subject with no manifest, or an unmigrated store all return an empty list rather than an error. Reads only.
fields.title: List suggested starter prompts

fields.description: Wipes the running firm state and rebuilds it from seed: every document status change, message and activity row created since boot is discarded. Also disconnects every seeded user's broker-side connected accounts and re-runs chip pre-generation. Returns fresh dashboard metrics.
fields.title: Reset the demo to its seeded state

fields.description: Appends a message to the client's thread attributed to the firm, and records a 'message_sent' activity event. The author is caller-supplied and defaults to Maya Alvarez — nothing checks it against the signed-in user. No API edits or deletes a sent message.
fields.title: Send a message to a client

fields.description: Applies a lifecycle transition to one stored document and appends an activity row. receive: missing -> received with a file name. verify: received|needs_review -> verified, which is TERMINAL (no transition leaves it). reject: back to missing, records the reason and deletes the attached file.
fields.title: Change a document's review status

fields.description: Demo choreography that writes real state: moves one missing document to received (variant 'correct') or to needs_review with an explanatory note (variant 'wrong'), attaches a generated file name, and appends a client-to-firm message plus activity. Requires the document to be in status missing.
fields.title: Simulate a client uploading a document
